thread:
pagerduty: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for INC-2026-0314-472 — service: inference-api, symptom: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (us-east-1). Pager: primary-oncall. link: https://pd.local/incidents/INC-2026-0314-472

oncall-bot: Auto-message: PagerDuty alert routed to #incidents and to @maria (primary) and @jordan (secondary). Please ack in thread.

maria: Acked. I'm on it. Starting triage — grabbing logs and recent deploys.

jordan: Thanks. Noted that customers are seeing failures; DN: some requests returning 502/504. Any recent infra changes?

maria: There was a rolling kernel patch rollout on the gpu-frontend pool 4m before the spike. Looking at load balancer + proxy logs now.

cheng: I see a sudden increase in upstream connection resets from model-proxy to runtime nodes in us-east-1. Could be NVLink driver hiccup.

maria: Confirmed: proxy logs show repeated `error: connection reset by peer` to runtime-node-12 and runtime-node-15. 15 is flapping.

nina: Adding customer impact: multiple enterprise customers (acct IDs ending in -87, -23) reported errors in the last 10m via support. (cc @support)

maria: Quick mitigation: removing runtime-node-15 from LB and shifting traffic to warm spare pool. Running the drain /standby commands: 
```# remove node
kubectl annotate node runtime-node-15 redwood/drain=now
sh scripts/remove-from-lb runtime-node-15 --region=us-east-1
```

maria: Executed removal, traffic shifted. Error rate dropped from 8% to ~1.2% in 90s. Still seeing occasional 502s.

jordan: Good. Who can own a deeper fix? We need to repro on runtime-node-15 and check kernel/driver logs. @cheng can you take lead?

cheng: I can. I'll repro on clone and run `dmesg` + `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=...` to check for driver OOM / reset. If it's a driver regression we may roll back the kernel patch.

sre-ops-bot: Reminder: Please update the incident doc in /incidents/INC-2026-0314-472 and log all mitigation steps.

maria: Customer-facing note for status page: "We experienced elevated 5xx errors for inference API in us-east-1 between 17:08 and 17:22 UTC. Mitigation applied — traffic shifted to spare capacity; root cause under investigation." Anyone object to posting this?

jordan: Post it. Add that we're monitoring and will follow up with an RCA.

cheng: Quick findings: kernel log shows GPU driver NVRM: Xid 13 (GPU hang) events just before connection resets. Replica affected had a pod on kernel 6.2. Rolling back to 6.1 yesterday passed. Root cause likely the 6.2 kernel + driver combo.

maria: Plan: keep node removed, cordon/mark for repro, and schedule rollback of kernel patch on remaining warm pool until we have a fix from driver vendor. Action owners: mar ia — mitigation/coordination, cheng — repro + logs, jordan — customer comms and status page updates.

nina: Support updated customers with the status page link and offered credits to impacted accounts.

maria: I'll handoff to cheng for the deeper investigation. I'm going to recover the on-call rotation in 10m. If anything spikes, ping me.

cheng: Taking over ownership now. I've started a VM clone and will run stress tests. ETA 45m for initial root cause verification.

pagerduty: Acknowledgement: incident acknowledged by maria at 1768504128; ownership transferred to cheng at 1768504520.

jordan: Thanks — ping here with updates every 15m. If you need escalation to infra-team or vendor, call it out.

cheng: Will do. First update 17:35 UTC.

sre-ops-bot: Incident checklist: mitigation applied, status page posted, on-call handoff noted, next update scheduled. Tagging for postmortem: @postmortem-team.

maria: Ending my active duty here. Handoff complete. :white_check_mark:

cheng: 17:35 update — repro shows repeated Xid 13 on kernel 6.2. Will coordinate rollback plan for the pool; scheduling with infra for a controlled rollback to kernel 6.1 starting in 30m.

jordan: Good work. We'll keep this thread as the canonical timeline. After rollback and stabilization we'll draft RCA and mitigation plan to avoid driver/kernel mismatches on rolling updates.

(reacts: :hammer_and_wrench: by jordan, :eyes: by nina)
